newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy diesel for June delivery.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy diesel for June delivery.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for June deliveries, traders said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 0.25 percent and 1.0 percent diesel for 40,000-45,0000 tonnes to be delivered to Kandla, on the Indian west coast and to Madras/Haldia on the east coast for the 1.0 percent only.
The tender closes on April 29 and offers will be valid until May 1.
IOC bought a total of 870,000 tonnes of diesel for May deliveries.
